title: Student-Informed Teacher Training

layout.note: Four panels in a row split by thin grey vertical lines, each with a plain title above and a letter below. (a) is a triangle of three network stacks joined by loss arrows; (b), (c) and (d) redraw the stacks side by side, once per phase, with the loss name under each.

lesson: To explain alternating training phases, redraw one network stack per phase in the same positions, grey out what is frozen, and show only that phase's loss as one coloured arrow with its name below; an overview panel can combine all the arrows.
